import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate the provided data by month and department.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')
pivot = df.pivot_table(index='年月', columns='診療科', values='患者数', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
pivot = pivot.sort_index()

ax = pivot.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, figsize=(8, 5))
ax.set_title('月別・診療科別の患者数合計')
ax.set_xlabel('年月')
ax.set_ylabel('患者数（人）')
ax.set_ylim(0, pivot.sum(axis=1).max() * 1.12)
ax.legend(title='診療科')
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
